name: Demon Slayer Morph Roleplay
desc:
Morph role-playing game based on Demon Slayer.
You can transform into a Demon Slayer character.
Play roles with your favorite characters and explore different places.


This game is not perfect yet, so you may find a flaw. If you report it through a group.
It will be very helpful for the game.
Tags: Demon Slayer, Morph Roleplay, Kimetsu no yaiba

scripts.title: Unlock all gamepass morphs
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("CharacterChangeEvent")

local isMorphing = false

-- ================= GUI CREATION =================
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "MorphMenu"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 350)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -120, 0.5, -175)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", mainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.Parent = mainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", titleBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local titleText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
titleText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleText.Text = "Morph IDs 1 - 150"
titleText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleText.TextSize = 14
titleText.Parent = titleBar

local statusLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
statusLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35)
statusLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLbl.Text = "Select a morph"
statusLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
statusLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
statusLbl.TextSize = 12
statusLbl.Parent = mainFrame

-- Fix Invisible Button
local fixBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
fixBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
fixBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 60)
fixBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
fixBtn.Text = "FIX INVISIBLE (Morph to 1)"
fixBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
fixBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
fixBtn.TextSize = 12
fixBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
fixBtn.Parent = mainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", fixBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

fixBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if isMorphing then return end
    isMorphing = true
    statusLbl.Text = "Fixing... Please wait 1s."
    statusLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
    Event:FireServer("CustomCharacter1")
    task.wait(1)
    isMorphing = false
    statusLbl.Text = "Ready."
    statusLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
end)

-- Scrolling Frame for 150 buttons
local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -100)
scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 95)
scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 120)
scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
scroll.Parent = mainFrame

local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 36)
grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
grid.Parent = scroll

-- Generate 150 Buttons
for i = 1, 150 do
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 36)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    btn.Text = "ID " .. i
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.LayoutOrder = i
    btn.Parent = scroll
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if isMorphing then
            statusLbl.Text = "Wait for cooldown!"
            statusLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
            return
        end
        
        isMorphing = true
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 0) -- Turns green
        statusLbl.Text = "Loading ID " .. i .. "..."
        statusLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
        
        Event:FireServer("CustomCharacter" .. tostring(i))
        
        -- 1 Second Cooldown
        task.wait(1)
        
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55) -- Turns back to normal
        isMorphing = false
        statusLbl.Text = "Ready."
        statusLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    end)
end

print("✅ Morph GUI Loaded. 1s Cooldown active.")
